WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
),
district_rank AS (
    SELECT first_name,
           District,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY first_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM admin_names
    WHERE first_name IN (SELECT first_name FROM top_names)
    GROUP BY first_name, District
)
